pages.title: Rooms
pages.content: Twenty-four ground-floor rooms on the Old Trunk Road at Harlow Crossing, each with its own parking bay at the door: Driver room €78, Step-free room €84, Twin room €92, Family room €118, per room per night, breakfast included.

pages.title: What a stay includes
pages.content: Breakfast at the counter from 05:00 to 09:30, a packed bag from 04:00, parking at your door, your room held until 06:00, quiet hours from 22:00 to 07:00, Wi-Fi and a desk lamp.

pages.title: Late arrivals
pages.content: The desk is awake until 02:00. After 02:00 your key waits in the night locker beside the desk door; the code comes in your confirmation text. A room booked for tonight is held until 06:00.

pages.title: The road
pages.content: Kilometre 212 on the Old Trunk Road at Harlow Crossing: the bakery at Orme is 4 km away, the lake lay-by 12 km, Harlow Crossing station 7 km.

pages.title: About
pages.content: Built in 1987 by the Varga family as a roadside motel, rebuilt and reopened in 2016 by Ines Varga. Michikusa means stopping by the roadside on the way somewhere.

pages.title: Questions
pages.content: Cancellation is free until 18:00 on the day of arrival; after that the first night is charged. Dogs €12 per night, car charging €9 per night, breakfast for a driver not staying €14.

pages.title: Book tonight
pages.content: Call the desk on +00 44 555 0142 (06:00–02:00) or email desk@michikusa-lodge.example. The desk replies by text within 15 minutes during desk hours with your room number.

pages.title: Road notes
pages.content: One letter a month: pass closures in winter, road works and breakfast changes. Write to desk@michikusa-lodge.example to join.

pages.title: Privacy
pages.content: We keep the name, phone number and arrival time you give us only for your stay.

pages.title: Terms
pages.content: Cancellation is free until 18:00 on the day of arrival; after that the first night is charged. Quiet hours 22:00–07:00. Check-out by 11:00.

pages.title: Thanks
pages.content: The desk will text you within 15 minutes during desk hours.

posts.title: How the 04:30 bag is packed
posts.excerpt: Eggs, bread, an apple and a flask of coffee: what goes into the packed bag Rafael leaves on the counter at 04:30.
posts.content:
Rafael lights the counter at four. By half past, the bag for the early driver is on the counter: two eggs, bread, an apple and a flask of coffee.

Ask for it at check-in and it is ready from 04:00, included in the room price.

posts.title: Charging overnight under the canopy
posts.excerpt: Six bays under the lit canopy charge overnight for €9 a night. How to ask for one.
posts.content:
Six bays under the canopy charge overnight for €9 per night. Ask at check-in and Desmond will switch one on.

The canopy light stays on all night, so you can see the cable and the car from your door.

posts.title: Three places to stop within twenty minutes
posts.excerpt: The bakery at Orme, the lake lay-by and the station at Harlow Crossing, all within a short drive of kilometre 212.
posts.content:
The bakery at Orme is 4 km away and opens at 06:30. The lake lay-by is 12 km down the road, a bench and still water at blue hour.

Harlow Crossing station is 7 km away, with a small cafe for the first train.
